analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABA-A receptors are primarily neuronal and are barely expressed in these nine non-neuronal cell lines, so inverse agonists at the benzodiazepine site should produce little transcriptional response, similar to other GABA-A-targeting classes. The closest analogs are therefore other GABA receptor ligands, especially the benzodiazepine-site inverse agonist and GABA receptor antagonist.
